Private Attributes

ValueArrayInternal * internal

Detailed Description

Store and manipulate an array of Value objects.

Note that if you have the same value in an array and evaluate each copy in the array it may return a different numerical value each time (if it is a RandomValue, SeriesValue or GeomValue for example).
